get_clients.label: Get Clients
get_clients.description: Lists the clients in the account, all of them or only those that are active, inactive or updated since a given time.

is_active.label: Is Active
is_active.description: Yes returns only active clients, No only inactive clients. Leave it empty for all.

updated_since.label: Updated since
updated_since.description: Only return clients that have been updated since the given date and time.

page.label: Page
page.description: DEPRECATED: The page number to use in pagination.

per_page.label: Records per page
per_page.description: The number of records to return per page. (1-2000)

get_estimates.label: Get Estimates
get_estimates.description: Lists the estimates in the account, filtered by issue date, state, client or update time.

from.label: From
from.description: Only return estimates with an issue_date on or after the given date. (YYYY-MM-DD)

to.label: To
to.description: Only return estimates with an issue_date on or before the given date. (YYYY-MM-DD)

state.label: State
state.description: Only return estimates with a state matching the value provided. Options: draft, open, accepted, or declined.

updated_since.label: Updated since
updated_since.description: Only return estimates that have been updated since the given date and time.

client_id.label: Client ID
client_id.description: Only return estimates belonging to the client with the given ID.

page.description: The page number to use in pagination.

per_page.label: Records per page
per_page.description: The number of records to return per page. (1-2000)
